pages.title: Visión General del Proyecto
pages.purpose: Introducción de alto nivel a AOSpainDX8: qué es, su historia, licencia, stack tecnológico (VB6 + DirectX 8) y la arquitectura de dos componentes (cliente + servidor). Incluye enlaces a todas las secciones principales.

pages.title: Primeros Pasos y Estructura del Repositorio
pages.purpose: Cómo configurar el entorno de desarrollo, dependencias necesarias (DX8VB.DLL, zlib.dll, quartz.dll, controles OCX), archivos del proyecto (CLIENT.VBP, SERVER.VBP) y la estructura de directorios de nivel superior.

pages.title: Licencia y Restricciones Legales
pages.purpose: Cobertura detallada de la licencia open‑source de Argentum Online: uso no comercial, obligaciones copyleft, requisitos de atribución y restricciones de marca.

pages.title: Arquitectura del Cliente
pages.purpose: Descripción del cliente del juego en VB6 (directorio cli/): pipeline de renderizado, audio, red, formularios de UI y gestión de assets. Enlaza a páginas hijas para cada subsistema.

pages.title: Motor de Renderizado
pages.purpose: Análisis profundo de TileEngine.bas y el pipeline de renderizado DirectX 8: tipos GrhData/Grh, bucle de dibujo de tiles, caché GDI BitBlt, minimapa, iluminación (Mod_Lighting.bas), render de daño (modRenderValue.bas) y migración DX7→DX8.

pages.title: Subsistema de Audio
pages.purpose: Cubre clsSoundEngine.cls, clsBufferMan.cls, Mod_Wav.bas, MoDuLo_MIDI.bas y Mod_MP3.bas. Explica DirectSound8, DirectMusic8 y streaming MP3 mediante quartz.dll. Describe el ciclo de vida del pool de buffers de sonido

pages.title: Red del Cliente y Protocolo TCP
pages.purpose: Cubre cli/codigo/TCP.bas: bucle de despacho HandleData, formato de paquetes, compresión vía zlib/modCompression.bas, control de socket CSWSK32.OCX y restricciones de preservación del protocolo cliente‑servidor.

pages.title: Formularios de Interfaz del Cliente
pages.purpose: Catálogo de todos los formularios VB6 en cli/codigo/: frmMain, frmConnect, frmCrearPersonaje, formularios de clanes, habilidades, comercio, banco, opciones y formularios de gestión de cuentas. Describe sus roles e interacciones.

pages.title: Datos y Recursos del Cliente
pages.purpose: Cubre los archivos índice en cli/Init/ (Graficos.ind, Personajes.ind, Ataques.ind…), assets PNG en cli/Graficos/, música en cli/Midi/, fuentes en cli/Recursos/Fuentes/ y el backup Init_old/. Explica cómo GameIni.bas carga la configuración.

pages.title: Server Architecture
pages.purpose: Overview of the VB6 server (Servidor/ directory): startup, configuration, module organization, and the main event loop. Links to child pages for each server subsystem.

pages.title: Server Configuration & Startup
pages.purpose: Covers Server.ini (IP, port, admin roles, faction armor IDs, MaxUsers), Dat/Motd.ini (message of the day format), Dat/NombresInvalidos.txt, FileIO.bas initialization routines, and the SERVER.VBP project structure.

pages.title: Server Networking & TCP Protocol
pages.purpose: Covers Servidor/Codigo/Modulos/TCP.bas: socket routing constants (ToIndex, ToAll, ToMap, etc.), COMMAND_BUFFER_SIZE, packet dispatch, the Queue.bas command buffer, and security classes (clsAntiDoS, clsAntiMassClon, UserIpAdress).

pages.title: Game Logic & World Simulation
pages.purpose: Covers GameLogic.bas (tile events, teleports, newbie checks), General.bas (server timers, intervals), Acciones.bas (player actions), Matematicas.bas (dice/RNG), and mdlLeeMapas.bas (map loading). Explains the main game loop and event-driven tick system.

pages.title: Combat System
pages.purpose: Covers SistemaCombate.bas: evasion modifiers per class, attack resolution, ranged combat (MAXDISTANCIAARCO), modHechizos.bas (spell casting, NPC spells), and PathFinding.bas (A* NPC navigation).

pages.title: NPC System & AI
pages.purpose: Covers AI_NPC.bas (AI behavior constants: ESTATICO, MUEVE_AL_AZAR, GUARDIAS_ATACAN_CRIMINALES, NPC_PATHFINDING, etc.), MODULO_NPCs.bas (NPC data structures and spawn logic), and the cGarbage.cls world-item cleanup system.

pages.title: Economy & Crafting
pages.purpose: Covers Comercio.bas (NPC-user trade), mdlCOmercioConUsuario.bas (player-to-player trade), modBanco.bas (bank system), InvUsuario.bas and Modulo_InventANDobj.bas (inventory management), and Trabajo.bas (crafting skills: stealth, fishing, smithing, etc.).

pages.title: Social Systems: Guilds & Factions
pages.purpose: Covers ModClanes.bas and cGuild.cls (guild creation, membership, elections, alliances/enemies, codex), cSolicitud.cls (join requests), ModFacciones.bas (EjercitoReal vs EjercitoCaos faction armor and rank), and GuildsInfo.inf persistence.

pages.title: Administration & Moderation
pages.purpose: Covers Admin.bas (GM/Dios/SemiDios roles, server intervals, MOTD), History.bas (server event logging), Modulo_SysTray.bas (system tray integration), and the server UI forms (frmMain, frmServidor, FrmStat, FrmInterv, frmTrafic, frmDebugNpc, frmDebugSocket).

pages.title: Data Persistence & File Formats
pages.purpose: Overview of all flat-file data storage used by the server: accounts, characters, maps, guilds, and configuration INI files. Links to child pages for each format.

pages.title: Account Files (.act)
pages.purpose: Covers the Servidor/Accounts/*.act INI format: [account_name] section (password MD5 hash, mail, Pregunta/Respuesta, ban flag) and [PJS] section (NumPjs, PJ1–PJ8 character slots). Explains the authentication and character-mapping subsystems.

pages.title: Character Files (.chr)
pages.purpose: Covers the Servidor/Charfile/*.chr INI format: all sections ([INIT], [STATS], [ATRIBUTOS], [Inventory], [BancoInventory], [HECHIZOS], [FLAGS], [REP], [GUILD], [MUERTES], [COUNTERS]). Explains inventory serialization (ObjN=ID-Amount-Equipped) and the progression model.

pages.title: Map Files & World Data
pages.purpose: Covers Servidor/Maps/MapaNN.inf binary map format (200×200 tile grids), mdlLeeMapas.bas loading logic, WorldBackUp/ snapshot directory, map metadata (terrain types: BOSQUE, NIEVE, DESIERTO, CIUDAD, DUNGEON), and tile exit/teleport structures.

pages.title: Server Configuration Files
pages.purpose: Covers Server.ini (all sections: INIT, Dioses, SemiDioses, AOSSLib), Dat/Motd.ini (color-coded MOTD format), Dat/NombresInvalidos.txt, Dat/FK.IND (forbidden keywords index), clsLeerInis.cls (INI parser utility), and Servidor/Libs/ OCX dependencies.

pages.title: User Management & Security
pages.purpose: Overview of how the server manages connected users, enforces connection limits, and prevents abuse. Links to child pages on user state and anti-cheat.

pages.title: User State & Session Management
pages.purpose: Covers Modulo_UsUaRiOs.bas (UserList array, tUser structure, session lifecycle), frmCargando.frm (loading screen), frmConID.frm (connection ID dialog), and the character creation flow (frmCrearCaracter, frmCrearPersonaje on the client side).

pages.title: Anti-Cheat & Connection Security
pages.purpose: Covers clsAntiDoS.cls (DoS detection), clsAntiMassClon.cls (mass clone prevention), UserIpAdress.cls (per-IP connection and character-creation tracking), MD5.bas (password hashing), Mod_Cripto.bas (client-side encryption), and PrivateCrcFunction.bas (CRC integrity checks).

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definitions of all codebase-specific terms, Spanish abbreviations, game-domain concepts, and technical jargon used throughout AOSpainDX8. Each entry includes file/function pointers for onboarding engineers.
